definitions.gloss: medicinal effect; therapeutic efficacy; pharmaceutical effect
definitions.explanation: The healing or therapeutic effect of a medicine, herb, or substance. Refers to how well a drug or remedy works to treat a condition.

examples.japanese: {薬効|やっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: It has a strong medicinal effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薬効|やっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This hot spring is said to have therapeutic effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢方薬|かんぽうやく}→漢方薬：17468_kanpouyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧{薬効|やっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: Traditional Chinese medicine is based on a different way of thinking about medicinal effects than Western medicine.

notes:
A compound of {薬|やく} (medicine) and {効|こう} (effect, efficacy). Used in medical, pharmaceutical, and traditional medicine contexts. Also commonly appears in descriptions of hot springs (⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧), herbs, and health foods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薬効|やっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a medicinal effect
- {薬効|やっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have a strong medicinal effect
- {薬効|やっこう}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: active pharmaceutical ingredient
- {薬効|やっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show therapeutic efficacy
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{薬効|やっこう}: therapeutic effects of hot springs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{効能|こうのう}→効能：11920_kounou⟧: efficacy, virtue — often used for hot springs and traditional remedies
- ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: effect, result — a more general term not limited to medicine
- ⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧: side effect — unintended effects of medicine, as opposed to the intended {薬効|やっこう}
